import cadquery as cq
import math

# === 参数 ===
flat_size = 5.5    # 对边距 (mm)
length = 10        # 长度 (mm)
hole_d = 3         # 通孔直径 (mm)

# === 建模 ===
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .polygon(6, flat_size * 2 / math.sqrt(3))
    .extrude(length)
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .hole(hole_d)
)

show_object(result)
